column1: # Lucene 10.5.0 lucene-monitor: every top-level class of the jar, and what became of it.
# Checked by scripts/check-port-inventory.py --module monitor (see its docstring for the statuses).

column3: detail
crates/lucene-monitor/src/facade.rs::Monitor -- match_docs runs each selected entry against the batch; resolve is QueryMatch::resolve
crates/lucene-monitor/src/facade.rs::Monitor -- the Simple and Scoring arms of match_docs
crates/lucene-monitor/src/loader.rs::ConcurrentQueryLoader
crates/lucene-monitor/src/handlers.rs::CustomQueryHandler

crates/lucene-monitor/src/facade.rs::QueryMatch -- Matcher::Explaining; the explanation of a fuzzy query is a flat match (see the ledger)
crates/lucene-monitor/src/index.rs::select_debug -- the wrapper only forces doc-by-doc scoring; the presearcher query is evaluated directly, so it has no counterpart
crates/lucene-monitor/src/facade.rs::QueryMatch -- Matcher::Highlights, with Hit ordered by position alone as Java's compareTo has it
crates/lucene-monitor/src/facade.rs::Matcher -- the enum of the four matchers
crates/lucene-monitor/src/facade.rs::MatchingQueries -- one document's matches, errors, queries run, build and search times
crates/lucene-monitor/src/facade.rs::Monitor
crates/lucene-monitor/src/config.rs::MonitorConfiguration -- an index path for the directory provider
crates/lucene-monitor/src/index.rs::MonitorQuery -- Defines a query to be stored in a Monitor
crates/lucene-monitor/src/serializer.rs::MonitorQuerySerializer -- fromParser's bytes, equal to Lucene's both ways
crates/lucene-monitor/src/config.rs::MonitorUpdateListener

crates/lucene-monitor/src/facade.rs::partition, Monitor::match_docs_partitioned -- the exact Java split of the queries

crates/lucene-monitor/src/presearcher.rs::TermFilteredPresearcher -- the abstract presearcher: its buildQuery/indexQuery pair, ported as the TermFilteredPresearcher methods; NO_FILTERING is presearcher::no_filtering

crates/lucene-monitor/src/index.rs::QueryCacheEntry -- QueryCacheEntry

crates/lucene-monitor/src/index.rs::QueryIndex

crates/lucene-monitor/src/index.rs::QueryIndex -- a read-only configuration opens the persisted index and refuses changes
crates/lucene-monitor/src/handlers.rs::RegexpQueryHandler -- tree, indexed terms and matches equal to Lucene's

crates/lucene-monitor/src/config.rs::SlowLog
